technique_name: Design a logo for a beach-themed restaurant.
description: The logo design utilizes a prominent wave icon to capture the essence of a beach-themed restaurant. The wave is designed to be bold, dynamic, and eye-catching, to capture attention and convey a sense of energy and excitement. The font is modern yet classic, and conveys a timeless elegance. Above the wave is the restaurant name in a distinct, custom font that uses various colors reminiscent of sunset colors to accentuate the beach theme.
